# Tiinex/site LLM Guide

Purpose:
Tiinex/site is the official thin web deployment over `@tiinex/app` and `@tiinex/core`. It is not the shared Tooling source, not canonical schema authority, and not the whole Tiinex project.

Read in this order:
1. README.md
2. tiinex.config.js
3. .topics/.workspaces/tiinex-site.workspace.md
4. .topics/026-thin-site-hygiene-historical-reduction-task.trace.md when working on Turn-2 history hygiene

Authority routing:
- Tiinex/docs owns maintained schema/semantic contracts.
- Tiinex/business owns organizational truth, priorities and human gates.
- @tiinex/core owns shared host-neutral mechanics and portable Handoff Tooling.
- @tiinex/app owns the reusable Viewer/application/Verse-host layer.
- this repository owns deployment configuration, web integration and hosting only.

Branch/currentness boundary:
- current source for this repository is grounded by its Workspace and task artifacts, not by historical `refactor`/PoC branch narratives;
- the current package/deployment workflow targets `master` after the Core/App split;
- never infer semantic authority merely from a branch or repository name.

Handoff/bootstrap boundary:
- for a qualified routed Handoff package, follow its Start/Continue protocol and its carried Core Tooling bootstrap;
- Site no longer owns `src/tooling/portable/**` bootstrap/runtime source;
- external-assistant bootstrap belongs to the Interop frontier when that repository is established.

History/reduction boundary:
- old `.topics/tooling/**` and `.topics/viewer/**` material is historical source awaiting exact destructive Reduction qualification;
- file age, extraction success, Git retention or a summary alone does not authorize semantic deletion;
- unresolved reduction preflight must fail closed.
